statement: Several interesting problems remain open. (i) Can we close the gap between lower bound of Ω(K) and upper bound of O(K 3 log2 K)? (ii) Can we prove an analogous result for weighted flow-time (with speed augmentation)? (iii) Can we generalize this result to the unrelated machines setting? (iv) Our lower bound of Ω(K)-competitive ratio relies on non-clairvoyance; can we prove a better bound if the processing times of tasks are known at their arrival times?
